profile.headline: Modem Software @ Google
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with several years of experience in embedded modem software development. My main passions lie within the areas of Distributed Computing and Telecommunications.

honors.title: Most Innovative Hack
honors.description: Won 2nd place at Qualcomm HackJuntos 2016, as the most innovative hack. HackJuntos is a Hackathon organized by LatinQ, the latin organization inside Qualcomm.

volunteerExperiences.description: In charge of establishing and leading a Jr. chapter of the Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers at a high school. The initiative aims to empower high school students in their endeavour to increase their knowledge and enthusiasm on STEM related fields.

Led a group of high school students through the diverse engineering workshops and presentations that took place during the Empower High School Conference at UC San Diego. This conference aims to incentivize interest in STEM related fields amongst high school students from under-represented groups through dynamic activities that challenge their view of careers in STEM.
